items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: I've made quite a few recordings with, like you said, Milt Buckner, Jo Jones and Big Joe Turner, the blues singer.

ctx.x: How did you find leading that band?

Well, we went over there more or less to make recordings and go on tour, you know, which we did make quite a few recordings. As of late, you know, as far back as 1972, I've made quite a few recordings with, like you said, Milt Buckner, Jo Jones and Big Joe Turner, the blues singer.
Oh, he worked with you all too?

items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: I made some...made some numbers over at...over in Paris with Slam Stewart, Jo Jones, Teddy Butler an' somebody else

ctx.x: Did ya ever record with them?

No, I never did. I made some...made some numbers over at...over in Paris with Slam Stewart, Jo Jones, Teddy Butler an' somebody else...I don't remember the name. We played over there. We made some records over in Europe...over in Paris there...somewhere in France. I don't know where we were. We were way out in...in the woods where some castle was. There was a big, ol' house looked like a castle. A man had a big studio over there, an' we played there for a long time. So now we gettin' up to time now. And we worked…
